description: Find commercial parcels by situs address. Matches whole words of the street line (the part before the first comma), normalized: 'Street' = 'St', 'Northwest' = 'N.W.' = 'NW'; a suite, unit, '#' or floor is ignored. Give a house number ('1200 Main', '1200 Main St NW') or a street name with its type ('Main St'); a city or a part of a word alone matches nothing. No match returns coverage: what this registry holds. Requires a FactLot Registry (public-record facts about commercial property, each cited to the source file and record).

query.description: Street address, or a house number and street words, or a street name with its type.

name: registry_search_address
title: Search parcels by address
